judgments.rationale: The header logo link (img alt 'Fleury', href '/'). This fails as reported.

judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: The 'FoundationOne®...' sidebar link at 390x844, reported as entirely hidden behind the OneTrust cookie banner. The probe's own record shows a race on load. The walk began about 3.9 s after load, before the banner appeared. At Tab 9 the banner was still sliding in: the recorded banner y of 548 is mid-animation, and its resting y is 452. On the very next step, focus was inside the banner, and the walk then reports a focus trap in the banner. I reproduced this live. Tabbing right after load, the link is first fully visible. The banner then slides over it for under a second, after which OneTrust moves focus onto the banner. With the banner showing, Tab, Shift+Tab and ArrowDown then Tab all keep focus inside the banner, behind a dark page filter, and Escape closes it. Per the 2.4.11 Understanding, making the banner modal so the user must dismiss it before navigating the page is a way to pass. A keyboard user is never left with focus on a hidden page element: the moment caught here is a brief animation race, after which focus goes to visible banner controls. The rule had this trap data in the same walk and still reported a failure.
